text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Arima Kinen, the
racecourse is
packed with spectators
who've been looking
forward to the
showdown between the BNW trio.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит tells Нарита Таисин and
Biwa
Hayahide that she's pumped and
ready to go for
the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the runners dash off onto the track,
they are
welcomed by thunderous
cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
